criteria.coder: writing, fixing, refactoring or testing source code
criteria.extract: pulling fields out of supplied text, short labelling or classification, or format conversion; no open-ended reasoning
criteria.reason: multi-step analysis, planning, maths or trade-off evaluation in English, without writing code
criteria.general: casual chat, translation, or writing in a language other than English
criteria.cloud: input stated to be larger than 32k tokens, or the user explicitly demands the frontier cloud model
criteria.none: none of these: needs non-text output or a capability no text model has (image/audio/video generation, live web browsing, phone calls)
